parameters.description: 赛维里安的暴击伤害提升60%，造成的伤害提升25%，若队伍中存在其他风属性角色则伤害额外提升30%；
parameters.descriptionEn: Severian's CRIT DMG increases by 60%, and his DMG increases by 25%. If there is another Wind character in the squad, his DMG increases by an additional 30%.

parameters.description: 赛维里安每拥有1%暴击率，会使自身的攻击力提升8.5点，最多计入100%暴击率。
parameters.descriptionEn: For every 1% CRIT Rate Severian has, his ATK increases by 8.5. This effect is capped at 100% CRIT Rate.

rules.condition: 队伍中存在[支援]、[击破]或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发
rules.conditionEn: When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character, or shares the same faction

parameters.description: 伊德海莉的暴击伤害提升40%；成功触发[溯寒]或[追碾]后，持续回复闪能，每秒回复0.5点，最多30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
parameters.descriptionEn: Yidhari's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

parameters.description: 零号·安比的暴击率提升12%；发动[终结技]时，零号·安比会获得6层[电鸣]（上限6层）；拥有[电鸣]后，零号·安比[特殊技：苍光]命中拥有[白雷]的敌人时，将改为消耗1层[电鸣]作为代替，同一招式命中多名敌人时最多消耗1层[电鸣]，消耗[电鸣]时仍会触发[白雷]的额外伤害；
parameters.descriptionEn: Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.

parameters.description: 「席德」的暴击伤害提升50%；
parameters.descriptionEn: Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
